args.answer:
No — Bay Auto Pages is out of date on price and Sundays. Its listing says flat $129 and open Sundays, but it is unclaimed and last updated March 2023.

Cormorant's own site (which outranks the directory) says:

- Closed Sunday and Monday — works Tuesday to Saturday only. So this Sunday, Sunday 2026-11-08, is not available. Next open slot listed is Saturday 2026-11-07 morning 08:00-09:30 (with a $25 Saturday fee).
- Full detail = The Schooner (exterior wash + interior detail + spray wax) costs $219 for a small vehicle, $249 midsize, $299 large, $399 oversized, before fees and tax — not flat $129.
- Your 2018 Corolla is small / Class A (Corolla is listed as example small car), so full detail base is $219.
- Your ZIP 94121 IS served with no travel fee — it is in the no-fee San Francisco list.
- Total math for Corolla full detail with no add-ons/fees in 94121: $219 + 8.625% sales tax = $237.89, not $129 + tax. Total = service + add-ons/surcharges + generator/timing fees + travel fee + tax.
- Bay Auto Pages also lists boat detailing and ceramic coating — Cormorant's own site says it does NOT detail boats/jet skis/motorcycles and does NOT do ceramic coating (longest protection is 6-month sealant).

If you want Saturday 11/7 morning in 94121 for the Corolla full detail, base would be $219 + $25 Saturday fee = $244 before tax, + 8.625% tax on $244 = ~$265.04, plus $50 deposit to book. Power needed: grounded 120V outlet within 75ft or $30 generator fee.

I have not booked anything.
